summary: Produced a compiled TikZ reconstruction (version 2, best version). It draws the hexagon A-B-C-D-E-F with centre O, the dashed diameter B-O-E, dashed radii and the dashed M-H segment, solid chords including C-H-E, and the right-angle mark at M. All 11 labels (A, B, C, D, E, F, G, H, M, N, O) are present and bound to their CV-measured points. The automatic critic scored v2 at 0.92 with must_repair=false, and the topology check passed with no missing edges.
